{
  "name": "waypoint",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "Project progress in one row above the Claude Code prompt: your /goal, checklists, roadmap, counters, beads epics, GitHub milestones, the agents working beside you and who holds a lock",
  "author": {
    "name": "VibeMage",
    "url": "https://github.com/VibeMage"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/VibeMage/claude-mod-waypoint",
  "repository": "https://github.com/VibeMage/claude-mod-waypoint",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "progress",
    "goal",
    "roadmap",
    "todo",
    "checklist",
    "beads",
    "milestone",
    "agents",
    "otty"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "auto (Chinese when LANG or the project's text is Chinese, else English), en or zh",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "zh"
      ]
    },
    "style": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Style",
      "description": "capsule: each item on a soft rounded fill; plain: items separated by dots",
      "default": "capsule",
      "options": [
        "capsule",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "refreshSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Refresh every (s)",
      "description": "How often files, panes and locks are re-read (5 to 600); beads and GitHub at most every 5 minutes",
      "default": 20
    },
    "showTeam": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show agents",
      "description": "The Claude Code and Codex panes working on the same project (needs Otty)",
      "default": true
    }
  },
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/VibeMage/claude-mod-waypoint/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png"
}
